sources.title: NFL Football Operations
sources.evidence: 2026 NFL RULEBOOK; rule changes and links to the official PDF.
sources.scope: Rulebook identity and scope only; no sportsbook settlement or model efficacy.

sources.title: NFL team statistics
sources.evidence: NFL 2026 REG - offense passing stats; passing, rushing, receiving, scoring and downs categories.
sources.scope: Category availability only. Extracted numerical rows lacked column headers; no statistics admitted to model data.

sources.title: NFL injury report
sources.evidence: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 9 of the 2026 Season. Columns: Player, Position, Injuries, Practice Status, Game Status.
sources.scope: Practice and game-status fields are distinct; dynamic page is not a historical as-of archive.

sources.title: scikit-learn cross-validation
sources.evidence: Training and testing on the same data is a methodological mistake; tuning on test data can leak knowledge.
sources.scope: Supports holdout design, not profitability or an NFL-specific sample-size guarantee.

sources.title: scikit-learn TimeSeriesSplit
sources.evidence: Other cross-validation methods can lead to training on future data and evaluating on past data; gap excludes samples.
sources.scope: Our proposed splitter operates on complete NFL weeks, not equally spaced individual bets.

sources.title: scikit-learn probability calibration
sources.evidence: Brier score and log loss assess reliability, resolution and uncertainty; lower Brier loss alone need not mean better calibration.
sources.scope: Use reliability bins as well as proper scores; no candidate has yet been evaluated.

sources.title: SciPy Pearson correlation
sources.evidence: Pearson r ranges from -1 to +1; constant-input correlation is undefined. Confidence intervals can use Fisher transformation or bootstrap.
sources.scope: No NFL correlation estimates verified. Pairwise r alone does not identify a higher-order joint distribution.

sources.title: SciPy bootstrap
sources.evidence: Bootstrap resamples with replacement; paired resampling uses the same indices; rng supports repeatability.
sources.scope: Week-block resampling is our dependence-aware project design, not a SciPy-endorsed NFL procedure. Percentile intervals have limitations.

sources.title: statsmodels multiple testing
sources.evidence: Test results and p-value correction for multiple tests; holm is step-down Bonferroni adjustment.
sources.scope: Project uses Holm correction across registered candidates, with valid input p-values still required.

sources.title: DraftKings general rules
sources.evidence: Retrieved introduction explicitly applies within Virginia; bet-slip language and rule hierarchy affect settlement.
sources.scope: Virginia snapshot only. Not proof of access, availability or applicable rules in Washington.

sources.title: DraftKings market rules
sources.evidence: Two-way point-spread ties after handicap and totals equal to line settle as Push; two-way moneyline ties settle as Push.
sources.scope: Generic retrieved market definitions only; sport-specific, jurisdiction and ticket terms must also be verified.

sources.title: Washington State Gambling Commission
sources.evidence: Sports wagering page links to requirements and rules, licensing, and the allowed wagering menu for tribal casinos.
sources.scope: Landing-page verification only; no personal eligibility or operator availability determination.

sources.title: GitHub Pages publishing source documentation
sources.evidence: Branch publishing supports repository root or docs; pushes to the configured source publish the site. A .nojekyll file permits static output without Jekyll processing.
sources.scope: Existing main/root Pages configuration retained because settings writes return HTTP 403. Actual deployment result is recorded separately.

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted team strength
strategies.method: Fit regularized offense/defense and home effects to pre-cutoff official game results; predict a discrete score distribution.
strategies.inputs: Rolling past-game scoring and opponent identities
strategies.risk: Shrink small samples; compare with intercept-only and no-vig market baselines.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

strategies.name: Possession and scoring-rate total
strategies.method: Model possessions and scoring per possession jointly; retain dispersion and discrete scores.
strategies.risk: Reject if drive-level provenance is missing; average points alone is not a distribution.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

strategies.name: Availability scenario mixture
strategies.method: Price separately under documented active/inactive scenarios, with weights estimated only from prior reports.
strategies.inputs: As-of official practice and game-status history
strategies.risk: Do not treat limited practice as ruled out; no invented injury impact or scenario weights.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

strategies.name: Opportunity × efficiency
strategies.method: Estimate attempts/targets/carries and conditional production with player/team shrinkage.
strategies.inputs: Official player game logs, role and availability history
strategies.risk: Test opportunity and efficiency separately; verify player IDs and participation settlement rules.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

strategies.name: Cross-game selective basket
strategies.method: Use a validated joint outcome distribution; retain shared uncertainty and synchronized offered quote.
strategies.inputs: Frozen single-leg probabilities, cross-game dependence and actual parlay quote
strategies.risk: Independence is a testable assumption, never a default; product of leg prices is not an executable quote.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

strategies.name: QB + receiver joint opportunity
strategies.method: Shared pass-volume and target-allocation simulation for quarterback and receiver legs.
strategies.inputs: Paired official game logs plus role, thresholds and same-game quote
strategies.risk: Joint tails must be calibrated; raw passing/receiving correlation is not hit-event correlation.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

strategies.name: Game-script team + player
strategies.method: Simulate score path, possessions, play selection and player volume together.
strategies.inputs: Official play-level histories and verified ticket rules
strategies.risk: Do not assume favorite + running-back over has a positive sign or profitable payout.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

strategies.name: Competing teammates / alternate thresholds
strategies.method: Model mutually constrained allocation and threshold nesting; integrate all legs jointly.
strategies.inputs: Paired player histories, participation and synchronized quotes
strategies.risk: Reject impossible combinations; three-plus-leg prices cannot be recovered from pairwise correlations.
strategies.implementation: research specification; probability utilities implemented, model not trained

gates.name: Provenance
gates.rule: Each observation needs official URL, retrieval time, published/as-of time, immutable content hash, entity/market ID and permission to use. Missing any required evidence blocks evaluation.

gates.name: As-of integrity
gates.rule: Features and quotes available no later than forecast cutoff; cutoff strictly before kickoff; results never features. Revisions retained separately.

gates.name: Registration
gates.rule: Freeze strategy version, feature rules, selection threshold, market, folds, risk caps and trial family before test exposure. Log all rejected trials.

gates.name: Walk-forward holdout
gates.rule: Train only before each complete test week; tune and calibrate inside training periods; embargo overlapping outcomes and keep all same-game legs in one fold.

gates.name: Probability quality
gates.rule: Report Brier, log loss and reliability-bin sample counts against constant and no-vig market baselines on identical non-push observations. Push models evaluated separately.

gates.name: Dependence
gates.rule: Estimate continuous residual and binary hit-event correlations separately; report sample and uncertainty. Require a validated full joint model for three-plus legs.

gates.name: Execution and settlement
gates.rule: Use archived executable quote at decision time, exact ticket/jurisdiction rules, line, price, void/push handling and costs; no retrospective best-price shopping.

gates.name: Statistical evidence
gates.rule: Use paired week-block bootstrap for score improvement and net returns; use valid one-sided evidence tests and Holm family-wise correction over all registered trials. Do not equate p-values with probability of skill.

gates.name: Stability and power
gates.rule: Pre-register power analysis, enough independent weeks, regime/season checks and drift limits. No universal sample count proves skill; report sensitivity to costs and model error.

gates.name: Reward eligibility
gates.rule: All gates pass, independent final holdout remains untouched, and lower confidence bound on cost-adjusted return is positive. Rank by paired out-of-sample Brier improvement lower bound, then log loss, then drawdown.

gates.name: Forward paper operation
gates.rule: Shadow-test frozen strategies on new games, monitor calibration and source freshness, stop on drift or missing data. Paper research only; no automatic wager placement.

correlations.note: Shared pass opportunity; estimate, do not assume sign.
Game-script dependence; outcome selection can distort association.
Shared team volume plus competing targets.
Potential shared model error; separate events do not prove independence.
Nested events; joint hit equals higher threshold event, not product.
Out-of-sample residual association, not raw-score association.
Pairwise correlations do not uniquely determine full joint probability.

flags.title: Historical official dataset
flags.detail: No provenance-complete historical game/play/player dataset ingested. A dynamic aggregate page is not an as-of training archive.
flags.impact: All models and backtests remain blocked.

flags.title: Executable odds archive
flags.detail: No verified timestamped singles, props or actual parlay quotes obtained. No current edge or closing-line value published.
flags.impact: Prices, ROI and betting recommendations blank.

flags.title: Correlation evidence
flags.detail: No paired, threshold-specific official observations approved. Signs, coefficients and intervals must not be invented.
flags.impact: Correlation cells blank; no independence assumption.

flags.title: Luck and skill
flags.detail: Finite samples cannot eliminate chance or guarantee future returns. Validation can reduce false discoveries, not certify risk-free skill.
flags.impact: No winning strategy, skill-only claim or guaranteed reward.

flags.title: Jurisdiction mismatch
flags.detail: Retrieved operator general rules explicitly describe Virginia. They do not determine availability or settlement in Washington.
flags.impact: Research only; location and ticket-specific checks required before any wagering.

flags.title: Dynamic injury report
flags.detail: Practice Status and Game Status are separate; blank injuries/game-status fields are not inferred. Snapshot is not historical availability.
flags.impact: No active/inactive assumptions or injury effect estimates.

flags.title: Extraction ambiguity
flags.detail: NFL aggregate numerical rows were returned without reliable column headers in extracted content. Values deliberately excluded.
flags.impact: No numeric team performance data copied.

flags.title: Broken injury-policy URL
flags.detail: Attempted legacy injury-policy URL returned 404 content; replaced by the official injury report, not by an invented policy.

flags.title: Broken NIST URL
flags.detail: Attempted NIST ANOVA background URL returned a page-not-found response. No claims attributed to it.
flags.impact: Statistical methods instead linked to checked official software documentation.

flags.title: Rewards not funded
flags.detail: Competition and research-point rewards are a proposed project policy; no cash pool, sponsor or payout exists.
flags.impact: No rankings or reward amounts issued without eligible evidence.

flags.title: Pages settings permission
flags.detail: GitHub Pages configuration writes returned HTTP 403. Existing main/root branch publishing is retained, with byte-identical generated root files.
flags.impact: No settings change required; deployment result tracked separately in coordination log.

flags.title: Automation boundary
flags.detail: Static site, tests and fail-closed report run automatically. Official historical data licensing/access and validated models are not implemented.
flags.impact: Dashboard is a research foundation, not a live betting feed.

requirements.delivery: Initial repository had only README.md; no legacy data/model to certify.
Primary-source catalog with checked scope and exclusions; no invented values.
Tested distribution-to-line utilities; trained, sourced production model blocked.
Eight explicitly unvalidated strategy specifications across all requested classes.
Eleven gates specified; fail-closed eligibility evaluator and tests implemented. No strategy passes yet.
Eight pair definitions; coefficients blank until official paired data exist.
Paper leaderboard and reward policy implemented as specification; no eligible entries or funded prizes.
Impossible guarantee explicitly rejected; uncertainty, holdouts and multiplicity used instead.
Executive overview, findings, limitations and priorities on dashboard and research report.
Static multi-page dashboard with row-level official-source links and review page; deployment tracked in coordination log.
Build/tests/report automated with no secrets; no fabricated substitute for inaccessible official historical data.
Every curated row audited for source references and claim scope; no claim that unavailable data or all external links were verified.

audit.finding: README.md contained only # Own9; no application, data, lockfiles, tests or hidden implementation outside .git.
No pre-existing board or claims. One integration session owns non-overlapping scopes; fixed Arena branch retained.
No real NFL prices, ROI, sample counts, rankings or correlations asserted. Synthetic unit-test fixtures never exported as observed results.
Official software documentation supports methods only; it does not verify strategy performance. Operator examples are jurisdiction-limited.
